subject.title: Feature: Add costCurrency config option to customize cost display currency

question: Should OpenClaw introduce a model-cost currency contract, and should that contract be per-model, per-provider, or a global display preference?
rationale: The request is useful, but current source explicitly treats model costs as USD and root policy sets a high bar for new config surface, so automation should not choose the permanent contract.

options.title: Design the currency contract first
options.body: Keep this issue open for maintainer direction, then implement a single documented currency field with USD default and coverage across config, registry, and UI displays.

options.title: Keep model costs USD-only
options.body: Leave model cost estimates in USD and rely on provider-usage balance snapshots for provider-native billing currencies.

options.title: Make it display-only
options.body: Add a user-facing display preference while keeping numeric model-cost semantics unchanged and documented as estimates.

recommendation.title: Design the currency contract first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for maintainer direction, then implement a single documented currency field with USD default and coverage across config, registry, and UI displays.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent usage pricing and Control UI history makes `vincentkoc` the strongest available routing candidate for the product-shape decision.
